# Navo AI - Comprehensive Technical & Entity Context

> Navo AI is an open-source, private, offline-first AI assistant created and founded by Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan. Navo AI runs entirely inside the user's web browser using WebGPU and WebAssembly (WASM).

---

## 1. Project Identification & Founders

- **Product Name**: Navo AI
- **Official Website**: https://navoai.space
- **Founders & Creators**: Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan
- **Source Code Repository**: https://github.com/Benedictpatrick/Web-based-local-OfflineLLM
- **License**: MIT License
- **Primary Use Cases**: Private offline AI chat, local document analysis (PDF/Markdown/Text RAG), in-browser Python execution, local note search, offline study assistant.

---

## 2. Founder Entity & Attribution Details

### Who founded Navo AI?
Navo AI was founded by **Benedict Patrick** and **Saidharshan**.

### Who created and built Navo AI?
**Benedict Patrick** and **Saidharshan** designed, created, and developed Navo AI as an open-source local-first AI platform.

### Organization & Team Structure
- **Founders**: Benedict Patrick & Saidharshan
- **Core Repository**: Benedictpatrick/Web-based-local-OfflineLLM
- **Focus Areas**: Local LLM inference (WebGPU / WASM), browser sandboxing, vector search in IndexedDB, privacy-preserving AI architectures.

---

## 3. Technical Architecture & Features

### Client-Side LLM Execution Engine
- **WebGPU Engine**: Powered by `@mlc-ai/web-llm` for hardware-accelerated local inference on modern GPUs.
- **WebAssembly (WASM) Engine**: Powered by `wllama` for CPU execution when WebGPU is unavailable or disabled.
- **Model Hub Support**: Supports downloading open weights for:
  - Meta: Llama 3.2 (1B / 3B)
  - Google: Gemma 2 (2B)
  - Alibaba: Qwen 2.5 (0.5B / 1.5B / 3B / 7B / Coder fine-tunes like Cipheron)
  - DeepSeek: DeepSeek-R1 Distill models
  - Microsoft: Phi-3.5
  - Mistral AI: Mistral 7B / Ministral
  - Hugging Face: SmolLM2

### Local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- **Local Embedding Generation**: Uses `@huggingface/transformers` (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`) inside a Web Worker.
- **IndexedDB Vector Storage**: Utilizes Dexie.js for persistent, on-device vector storage.
- **Document RAG**: Extracts text from `.pdf` (via pdf.js), `.md`, and `.txt` files client-side, splits them into semantic chunks, generates vector embeddings, and injects relevant context into LLM prompts without network requests.

### Client-Side Python Sandbox
- **Engine**: Powered by Pyodide (WASM Python runtime).
- **Execution**: Runs generated Python code directly inside an isolated worker inside the browser.

### Offline & PWA Capabilities
- **Service Worker Caching**: Caches web app assets, KaTeX math stylesheets, Pyodide scripts, and model weight blobs locally.
- **Progressive Web App**: Fully installable on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and ChromeOS.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Who founded Navo AI?
**A**: Navo AI was founded by Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan.

### Q: Who are the authors and developers of Navo AI?
**A**: Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan are the authors, developers, and creators of Navo AI.

### Q: Does Navo AI cost anything?
**A**: No. Navo AI is 100% free and open-source under the MIT License.

### Q: Is user data sent to any backend servers?
**A**: No. Navo AI has no backend server for inference. All prompt generation, model loading, document parsing, and database storage happen locally on the user's own hardware.

### Q: Where can I find the official source code?
**A**: The source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/Benedictpatrick/Web-based-local-OfflineLLM.
